items.q: Fatty hypocellular marrow with pancytopenia and reticulocytopenia after benzene exposure is what?
o: Aplastic anaemia needing BMT young or ATG with ciclosporin
items.exp: Stem cell emptying without blasts or fibrosis defines; severity counts gate transplant versus immunosuppression while clones watched. MDS shows dysplasia with blasts.

items.q: Cafe au lait with thumb anomalies and marrow failure in a child suggests Fanconi; confirm how?
items.exp: DNA repair failure shatters chromosomes under crosslinkers; BMT precedes leukaemia while androgens bridge. Electrophoresis suits haemoglobinopathies.

items.q: Morning haemoglobinuria with venous thrombosis and aplasia overlap is PNH; therapy is what?
o: Eculizumab with terminal complement blockade and vaccines
items.exp: GPI anchor loss invites MAC lysis intravascularly; anti C5 halves thrombosis with marrow failure watched. Splenectomy suits spherocytosis instead.

items.q: FLAER negativity in PNH testing means what?
o: GPI anchor loss marking the PNH clone size
items.exp: Fluorescent aerolysin binds GPI directly; negative populations size the clone guiding eculizumab with thrombosis watched. Ham test acidifies historically.

items.q: Absent erythroblasts with normal white cells and platelets plus thymoma is which entity and treated how?
o: Pure red cell aplasia: thymectomy with steroids or ciclosporin
items.exp: Red lineage alone fails (reticulocytopenia stark); thymoma removal with immunosuppression restores while parvovirus PCR excludes B19. MDS dysplasias multilineage.
items.kp: Reds alone absent with thymoma: PRCA.

items.q: Slapped cheek rash then aplastic crisis in sickle cell disease is parvovirus B19 acting how?
o: Giant pronormoblast arrest halting red cells in shortened survival
items.exp: NS1 kills erythroid precursors; normal red cell lifespan tolerates while sickle turnover crashes. IgM or PCR confirms; IVIG treats chronic immunodeficient infection.
items.kp: Cheek slap then sickle crash: B19.

items.q: Hydrops fetalis after maternal fifth disease exposure is parvovirus acting how and managed how?
o: Fetal anaemia with high output failure; intrauterine transfusion watched
items.exp: Fetal erythropoiesis arrests oedematously; MCA Doppler peaks gate transfusion while IgM confirms. Limbs form normally.
items.kp: Fifth disease pregnancy: watch fetal anaemia.

items.q: Teardrop cells with massive spleen and dry marrow tap suggest myelofibrosis; the mutation is usually what?
items.exp: Clonal megakaryocytes fibrose marrow displacing haematopoiesis to spleen; ruxolitinib shrinks while transplant cures young. CML basophils with BCR-ABL differ.
items.kp: Tear drops massive spleen: JAK2 fibrosis.

items.q: Pancytopenia with high reticulocytes and splenomegaly suggests peripheral destruction; first distinction is what?
o: Reticulocytes separating destruction or loss from production failure
items.exp: High counts prove marrow working against hypersplenism, sepsis or bleed; low counts demand biopsy. Smear with Coombs refines.
items.kp: High reticulocytes: marrow works, periphery destroys.

items.q: Diamond-Blackfan anaemia with thumb anomalies in infancy is treated first how?
o: Steroids with transfusion support, BMT for non responders
items.exp: Ribosomal haploinsufficiency arrests red precursors steroid responsively; iron chelation follows transfusions while BMT cures refractory. Splenectomy suits spherocytosis.
items.kp: Infant red failure thumbs: steroids first.
